## Summary

Found the bug: `PasswordResetWorkflow::execute` called `UserService::change_password()` (which already sends the "Password Changed" email internally) and then sent a second, duplicate email itself.

Fixed by removing the redundant `notification_service_.send_email(...)` call in `src/workflow/password_reset_workflow.cpp:6-11`, leaving the workflow to simply delegate to `UserService::change_password`.

Verified with `test_008.cpp` (compiled via clang++, since no `g++`/`cl` was on PATH):
- Profile-based password change → 1 email
- Password reset workflow → 1 email (previously 2)

Both scenarios pass (`SUCCESS`).
